explication: easyjson is a Go library and code-generation tool for reflection-free JSON marshaling and unmarshaling. The main workflow is: a developer invokes the CLI, which parses Go types and bootstraps the generator; generated code then uses the runtime lexer and writer, while the library helpers expose serialization APIs. The graph also includes optional-value wrappers, raw JSON, unknown-field handling, and buffer pooling. Runtime call details are limited to the provided excerpts and source index; documented generation relationships are identified as such.
